entities.summary: Éric Roger Pierre Lombard is a French businessman and politician who served as Minister of Economics and Finance in the government of Prime Minister François Bayrou from 2024 to 2025. From 2017 to 2024, he served as CEO of the Caisse des dépôts et consignations.
